info.name: Auth
info.description: Complete API collection for Rufieltics application including Authentication and User Management

exec: // No User-Agent override — Postman sends its own UA automatically.
// The device fingerprint is locked at login time to whatever UA is
// used for the login request. Changing the UA on subsequent requests
// will trigger a 401 (device binding mismatch), as expected.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints for registration, login, and email verification

request.description: Register a new user account. User will be created with isActive=false and requires email verification. A 6-digit verification code will be sent to the provided email address.
Verify email address with the 6-digit code received via email. Upon successful verification, the user's isActive will be set to true and emailVerifiedAt will be updated.
Resend verification code to the email address. The previous code will be invalidated and a new 6-digit code will be sent. Rate limited to 3 requests per hour per email.
Login with email and password. Returns access token and refresh token. Only active users (isActive=true) can login.

exec: // Clear stale cookies so the fresh ones from login take effect.
// The httpOnly deviceSecret cookie is managed entirely by the
// cookie jar — Postman sends it automatically on matching paths.

request.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. The used refresh token is immediately invalidated (single-use rotation). If the same refresh token is used twice, both are revoked.

header.description: Required — CSRF token received at login (double-submit cookie pattern)

request.description: Revokes the current session. Deletes the refresh token from Redis and marks the DB session as isRevoked=true. Subsequent /auth/refresh calls with the same token will return 401.
Check your own verification lockout status. Returns whether you're locked, the reason, expiry time, and remaining seconds/minutes. Authenticated users only.

Send a 6-digit OTP to the given phone number. Requires an active session (Bearer token). A new OTP cannot be requested while a valid one is still alive (10-minute cooldown). Console logs the code in local dev.

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Cooldown Active (Should Fail)

request.description: Sending a second OTP before the first expires. Expects 400 with phone_otp_still_valid error and remaining cooldown duration.

exec: pm.test('Rejected while OTP still valid', function () {

request.description: Submit the OTP received via SMS (or from console log in dev). On success the user's phoneVerifiedAt field is set and the updated user is returned.

item.name: Verify Phone OTP - Wrong Code (Remaining Attempts)

request.description: Submit an intentionally wrong OTP. Expects 400 with remaining attempt count. After 3 failed attempts the phone is locked for 24 hours.

exec: pm.test('Wrong OTP returns remaining attempts', function () {

request.description: Attempt to verify after the OTP has expired (10-minute TTL). Expects 400 with phone_otp_expired error.

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Locked Phone (Should Fail)

request.description: Attempt to send an OTP to a phone that is currently locked (after 3 failed verifications). Expects 400 with phone_locked error and remaining lockout duration.

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Suspicious Activity Block

request.description: Simulates a phone blocked with SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY reason (set manually in DB or triggered by security events). Expects 400 with phone_locked_suspicious error mentioning 'suspicious activity' and a support contact hint.

exec: pm.test('Suspicious activity block returns specific error', function () {

request.description: Same as Send Phone OTP but with Accept-Language: id — response messages should be in Indonesian.

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Number Taken By Another Account (Should Fail)

request.description: The phone number on this account matches another account that has already verified the same number. Expects 400 phone_taken. Note: only a *verified* holder of the same number triggers this — an unverified collision does not block.

exec: pm.test('Number already used by another account', function () {

item.name: Verify Phone OTP - Number Taken By Another Account (Should Fail)

request.description: Another account has already verified this same number between send and verify. Expects 400 phone_taken — prevents a race where two accounts race to verify the same number.

exec: pm.test('Number taken at verify time', function () {

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Phone Not On Account (Should Fail)

request.description: Pass a phone number that does not match the phone stored on the account (or no phone on account). Expects 400 phone_not_recognized — not expired/lockout messages, because the number isn't associated with this user at all.

exec: pm.test('Unrecognized phone returns distinct error', function () {

item.name: Verify Phone OTP - Phone Not On Account (Should Fail)

request.description: Pass a phone number that does not match the phone stored on the account. Expects 400 phone_not_recognized — not expired/lockout/invalid-code messages.

exec: pm.test('Unrecognized phone returns distinct error on verify', function () {

item.name: Send Phone OTP - Already Verified (Should Fail)

request.description: Attempt to send an OTP to a phone that is already verified on the account. Expects 400 with phone_already_verified — a distinct message that does not mention lockouts, expirations, or attempt counts.

exec: pm.test('Already-verified phone returns distinct error', function () {

item.name: Verify Phone OTP - Already Verified (Should Fail)

request.description: Attempt to verify a phone that is already verified. Expects 400 with phone_already_verified — not expired/invalid-code messages.

exec: pm.test('Already-verified phone returns distinct error on verify', function () {

item.name: Admin - Lockout Management
item.description: Admin-only endpoints for managing verification lockouts

query.description: Filter by status: active, cleared, or all (default: active)
Filter by reason: TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS, SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY, MANUAL_LOCK
Sort by: lockedAt, expires, or email (default: lockedAt)
Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

request.description: List all verification lockouts with pagination and filters. Admin privileges required. Returns email, IP address, user agent, reason, timestamps, and remaining time for active lockouts.
List only cleared (resolved) lockouts with clearedAt and clearedBy information.
Find all lockouts (active and cleared) for a specific email address.
Get detailed information about a specific lockout by ID. Admin privileges required.
Manually clear a lockout to allow the user to attempt verification again. Admin privileges required. Records the admin ID who cleared the lockout and removes it from both database and Redis.

item.name: Admin - Login Lockout Management
item.description: Admin-only endpoints for managing login lockouts (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS, SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY, MANUAL_LOCK)

request.description: Manually lock a user's login with reason MANUAL_LOCK. Optional ttlSeconds sets the lockout duration (max 604800 = 7 days). Defaults to progressive TTL based on prior lockout history if omitted.

exec: console.log('Manual login lockout created for: ' + response.data.email);

query.description: Filter by status: active, cleared, or all (default: active)
Filter lockouts created on or after this date (ISO 8601)
Filter lockouts created on or before this date (ISO 8601)
Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

request.description: List all login lockouts with pagination and filters. Returns reason (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS / SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY / MANUAL_LOCK), IP address, user agent, timestamps, and remaining seconds for active lockouts.

exec: console.log('First login lockout ID saved: ' + response.data.data[0].id);

request.description: Find all login lockouts (active and cleared) for a specific email address. Useful for reviewing the lockout history and understanding progressive escalation.
List only cleared login lockouts with clearedAt and clearedBy information.
Get detailed information about a specific login lockout by ID, including reason, remaining time, and who cleared it (if cleared).
Manually clear a login lockout so the user can attempt login again. Clears all active login lockouts for that email and removes the Redis key. Records the admin ID who performed the clear.

item.name: User Management
item.description: User CRUD operations and management endpoints (typically admin or self-only)

request.description: List all users with basic pagination.

query.description: Searches in name, email, and username fields

request.description: Search users by name, email, or username.

query.description: Filter by tier level: BASIC, PRO, or PREMIUM

request.description: Filter users by multiple criteria including active status, staff status, 2FA, and tier level.
Filter users by specific email or name fields.

query.description: Set to 'true' to include soft-deleted users in results

request.description: Get all users including soft-deleted ones. Check the 'deletedAt' field to identify deleted users.

query.description: Sort by: createdAt, updatedAt, email, name, username, lastLoginAt

request.description: Sort users by various fields in ascending or descending order.
Get detailed information for a specific user by ID.

header.description: Required — must be the token of the user being updated

request.description: Update own profile. Requires a valid access token. Only name, username, password, and avatar can be updated here. Privilege fields (isActive, isStaff, isTwoFactorEnabled) are intentionally excluded — use the admin endpoint for those.

header.description: Required — must be a staff (isStaff=true) access token

request.description: Admin-only endpoint to update privilege fields (isActive, isStaff, isTwoFactorEnabled). Requires a Bearer token from a user with isStaff=true. Returns 403 for non-staff callers.
Update user password. Password must be at least 8 characters with complexity requirements. passwordChangedAt will be automatically updated.
Delete a user by ID.
Admin endpoint to create a user directly (bypass registration flow). User will still be created with isActive=false unless explicitly set.
Test validation error messages in Indonesian. Should return all validation errors translated to Bahasa Indonesia.
Test verification with invalid code. Should return error message.
Test login with unverified account (isActive=false). Should return error indicating account needs verification.
